articles.dek: “A blue tsunami” - that's what political commentators on Wednesday called the decisive victory for Democrats and the resounding loss for US President Donald Trump's Republican party in the midterm elections. articles.dek: Much like 2022, the 2026 midterm elections proved the majority of voters support reproductive rights and abortion access. Four states had abortion on the ballot.
